acceptanceBoundary: One accepted registry record represents one lawfully obtained and fully profiled dataset package/source family. Archives or constituent experimental subsets inside the same published package are documented but do not inflate the fully-profiled-dataset target. Measured scalar samples are counted separately from dataset packages and moulding cycles.

datasets.title: Data Model for Injection Molding and Blow Molding
datasets.notes: Blow-moulding rows were excluded. This package contributes one fully profiled dataset but no high-frequency time-series samples.

datasets.title: High-resolution injection-moulding time-series datasets (scatimdata)
datasets.notes: The source contains three published experimental datasets, but they remain one source family for the hard fully-profiled-dataset count. The sample ledger counts only observed physical numeric signal values and excludes axes, identifiers and state arrays.

datasets.title: Hot-runner molded sustainable-material experimental supplementary data
datasets.notes: The downloadable CSV has 42 analytical processing/property columns plus three leading index fields. It is accepted as one record-level measured dataset package; it does not add high-frequency waveform samples.

datasets.title: OpenMMS-T4G real-world injection-mold monitoring case study
datasets.license: BSD-3-Clause repository / CC BY 4.0 companion article
datasets.notes: The paper-linked raw CSV contains two acquisition-module clocks plus ten physical sensor channels. Only the physical sensor values count as measured scalar samples. Inertial source-scale ambiguity is explicitly retained rather than silently converted.

datasets.title: Injection-Molding Production Data with Quality Labels
datasets.license: Current B2SHARE v2 record is Dataset Open; displayed licence field blank; no raw redistribution claimed
datasets.notes: Exact v2 Parquet MD5/SHA-256 and schema are recorded. The publisher describes 334 features but the file physically contains 364 Arrow fields; the discrepancy is preserved. SIM_* and CALC_* fields, setpoints, trigger/state arrays and aggregate summaries are not treated as direct measured waveform samples.

datasets.title: Injection-Molding Production Data with Quality Labels (d-optimal Design of Experiment pattern)
datasets.license: Creative Commons Attribution (CC-BY), version not specified in EUDAT B2FIND metadata
datasets.notes: Exact Parquet MD5/SHA-256 and schema are recorded and the observed 396 fields reconcile with the publisher's feature count. Physical time-series arrays are retained as real measured evidence, but their scalar values remain outside the sample ledger until per-channel time bases and direct-measurement masks are normalized.

datasets.title: Injection Molding Dataset (Viscometer, Euromap77, Quality Table)
datasets.license: Current B2SHARE record is Dataset Open; displayed licence field blank; no raw redistribution claimed
datasets.notes: All three current B2SHARE Parquets match the publisher-displayed MD5 values. The pressure file contains 18,000,000 rows across 60 cycles, not the 1,048,575 rows implied by the description PDF; experiments 16 and 17 have no pressure traces. Only the two direct physical pressure channels count, giving 36,000,000 samples. Time and the derived pressure-difference field are excluded. EUROMAP raw-scale/documentation inconsistencies are retained without undocumented conversion.
